title: Annual City Wide Garage Sale Returns August 14-16
snippet: The annual City Wide Garage Sale is returning for 2026! It'll be held the weekend of Friday, August 14-Sunday, August 16 and run once again by the Cool City Committee. Follow their Facebook Page for updates and more announcements.

title: Jefferson Project in its final phase!
snippet: The Southeast Macomb Sanitary District (SEMSD) Jefferson Relief Sewer Project is entering its final phase of tunneling next week along Jefferson Avenue. The remaining tunneling work is expected to be completed by January.

title: Jefferson Paving Has Begun!
snippet: As part of the ongoing Jefferson Relief Sewer Project, paving operations on Jefferson Avenue between 9 Mile Road and Fresard Street are scheduled to begin today. The contractor is working from 9 Mile north to Fresard.
